title: Calm Happy Breathing Song
hook: If one tool does not fit, choose another or ask for help.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: warm 3D feelings storybook, expressive friendly faces and simple social-emotional tools, uncluttered scenes; visual identity: Calm Happy Breathing Song

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child choosing among regulation supports
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Repair Calm Happy Breathing Song into a regulation-choice song: breathing, quiet space, movement, music, rest, contact, and talking are options; no strategy is guaranteed and happiness is not the required endpoint.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child samples low-intensity options and can stop, switch, or seek support if a tool feels wrong.
